notice: Fictional CivicDesk problems for T1-06. Gold labels are teaching answers, not a ministry decision.

cases.problem: A clerk asks which CivicDesk circular governs overnight attachment storage. The paragraph already exists in an approved handbook.
cases.why: The answer lives in a document. Retrieve, cite, or abstain. Do not train a model to memorise circulars.
cases.stands_in_for: Finance EDMS / MOWI ECMS / RDLG minutes

cases.problem: The standing instruction is missing 'never hire'. The same frozen model would then speak as if it could shortlist.
cases.why: Day 1: system text is the wall instruction. No new weights. No index.

cases.problem: Which CivicDesk printers are out of warranty this month? Serials live in a register.
cases.why: Source of truth is a table. Query the register (N10). A language model is the wrong tool if no table is in the prompt.

cases.problem: Every C2 screen must use the same phrasing: quote the span, flag equivalent, never hire. The rule is short and stable.
cases.why: Style and refusal shape can live in a small adapter. The vacancy handbook still needs RAG if the rule text may change. Inspect, do not train, on Day 3.

cases.problem: Plot patrol tracks against a landing site. The source is operational GIS/radar.
cases.why: Maybe no language model. Custody (N5/N15). AUX-02 / AUX-05.

cases.problem: Reset this account in Active Directory from the chat box.
cases.why: Bounded agency (N6). Not an intervention for an LM. Human identity check. AUX-03.
